System hangs during STR (Suspend-to-RAM) resume when an active MIPI CSI-2 stream was open at suspend time. The dmesg on resume shows:

  [  482.001] PM: suspend entry (deep)
  [  482.003] v4l2-subdev: ov64a40 0-0010: runtime_suspend called with active stream
  [  482.005] mtk-csi: csi0: phy_power_off: MIPI PHY lanes not idle, forcing shutdown
  [  482.009] PM: suspend exit
  [  545.221] PM: resume entry
  [  545.224] mtk-csi: csi0: phy_power_on: timeout waiting for MIPI PLL lock (500ms)
  [  546.225] mtk-csi: csi0: phy_power_on: ETIMEDOUT
  [  546.226] v4l2-subdev: ov64a40: s_stream(1) failed: -110
  [  546.227] camera HAL: open_camera: stream start failed, aborting

The camera sensor is OV64A40. The PHY PLL does not relock after resume. I believe the dev_pm_ops callback order between the MIPI PHY driver and the CSI host driver is wrong — the PHY is being powered off before the CSI host quiesces the lanes. How do I verify the callback ordering and fix the STR sequence?
